Actor Pankaj Tripathi's brother attacked in land dispute; accused arrested

The brother of actor Pankaj Tripathi was attacked with an axe in Gopalganj, Bihar, reportedly over a land dispute. He has been hospitalized following the incident. Police have arrested at least one accused person in connection with the attack and are conducting a probe.
